title: Synthetic example: finding patterns in geological observations
abstract: This is a synthetic demonstration record. Geology brings together observations of rocks, structures, and physical measurements. This example describes how segmentation can group neighboring observations into candidate regions. It does not report a real study or measured result.

title: Synthetic example: comparing evidence across spatial scales
abstract: This is a synthetic demonstration record. Geology uses measurements at different spatial scales. This example describes comparing local observations with regional patterns while retaining uncertainty. It does not report a real study or measured result.
